_comment: Candidate-specific packaging manifest for the Frontera runtime. Produced by P0-PKG-02 (Protocol RC adoption) and corrected by P0-PKG-03 (self-contained artifact). It records the identity of a produced artifact and authorizes nothing: no registry publication, no tag, no GitHub Release, no merge. release/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json (the v1.0.0 release manifest) is a separate, machine-generated file and is not this document.
exports_fingerprint_note: sha256 of the canonically ordered exports object (10 keys), computed the way Soberania Protocol computes its own. Unchanged since origin/main.
license: UNLICENSED (proprietary; LICENSE ships in the tarball)
